_doc: Every box read by eye in both years at 2.6-8x crops with my own metre ticks computed from box_en (15.16 px/m); a post counted only with its signature (a stroke from one foot in both years, or one year plus a head where the other is in shadow); feet located to ~0.5 m; strokes under ~1.5 m in 2022 treated as meters/bollards; a tall pole whose shadow ends in a lamp head and that carries only ped heads is called lamp, a pole with an arm of signal heads over the road is a mast.

wrong_class.note: tall pole whose 2022 shadow runs 6-8 m north and ends in a cobra/lamp head (2020 shadow agrees); the signal heads on it are pedestrian heads, no signal arm over the road
